cohort: The study included 154 primiparous women admitted to Baoji People's Hospital between July 2020 and September 2023, divided into an observation group (n=58) and a control group (n=96).
finding: The Internet-based integrated care model significantly improved breastfeeding knowledge, self-efficacy, and exclusive breastfeeding rates, and supported better infant physical development in primiparous women.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as an independent risk factor for exclusive breastfeeding.
